raw_response:
The figure contains two line plots comparing the training rewards of two algorithms, "Llama-On-Policy" and "Llama-LUFFY", across different training set difficulties: "Easy" and "Hard". Both plots share the same x-axis, labeled "Steps", ranging from 0 to 500 with tick marks at intervals of 100. The y-axis is labeled "Training Rewards" and ranges from 0.0 to 0.4 in the top plot and 0.0 to 0.2 in the bottom plot, both using a linear scale. In the top plot ("Easy Training Set"), the "Llama-On-Policy-Easy" line (dark teal, solid line with circular markers) starts near 0.0 and rises to approximately 0.35 by 500 steps, with a shaded region indicating variability. The "Llama-LUFFY-Easy" line (red, solid line with circular markers) also starts near 0.0 and rises to approximately 0.38 by 500 steps, with a similar shaded region. In the bottom plot ("Hard Training Set"), the "Llama-On-Policy-Hard" line (dark teal, solid line with circular markers) starts near 0.0, rises to about 0.05 at 100 steps, then declines to near 0.0 by 200 steps, and remains near 0.0 through 500 steps. The "Llama-LUFFY-Hard" line (red, solid line with circular markers) starts near 0.0, rises to about 0.15 at 100 steps, and continues to increase to approximately 0.20 by 500 steps, with a shaded region indicating variability.
